title: thunder
summary: Hammer Time: Days of Thunder is a fan-written science fiction adventure, billed as a tale of undocumented features and set in a shared universe that mixes Transformers, Robotech-style space opera and a rock-and-roll band of spacefaring survivors. The story follows the Clay Pigeons, a band that doubles as a mercenary unit calling itself Thunder Force, after the collapse of the Wedge Defense Force has left its members scattered and hunted by old enemies. Their leader Martin, a musician and tactician, keeps the group together through concerts, pirate hunts and personal tensions among a crew that includes human pilots, a Valkyrie-piloting engineer, a Transformer named Blaster and a giant mute bassist. Chapters move between backstage banter, rehearsals, tense strategy sessions and space combat, with a lot of playful pop-culture references and running jokes. The excerpts show the group weighing whether to stay together, planning a concert despite threats, and answering a distress call from a trading fleet attacked by pirates. The tone is comic and affectionate, with the band's camaraderie and bickering at the centre of the action.
